findings.detail: Service account has 1 user-managed JSON key(s) (long-lived credentials).
findings.remediation: Delete user-managed keys and use workload identity / impersonation.

findings.check_title: Primitive role assigned to a human user
findings.detail: Primitive role roles/owner assigned to a human user.
findings.remediation: Replace primitive roles with least-privilege custom roles and groups.

findings.check_title: Project IAM binding grants anonymous/all-authenticated access
findings.detail: No bindings for allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers.
findings.remediation: Remove public bindings; use signed URLs / IAP where sharing is required.

findings.detail: Bucket is publicly readable (allUsers in IAM policy or legacy ACL).
findings.remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bindings and enable public access prevention.

findings.detail: Uniform bucket-level access is disabled (legacy object ACLs in use).
findings.remediation: Enable uniform bucket-level access on all buckets.

findings.detail: Object versioning is disabled.
findings.remediation: Enable versioning on buckets holding mutable data.

findings.check_title: Bucket not using customer-managed encryption key
findings.detail: Bucket uses Google-managed encryption keys, not a CMEK.
findings.remediation: Configure default KMS keys on buckets where required.

findings.check_title: Bucket not using customer-managed encryption key
findings.detail: Bucket uses Google-managed encryption keys, not a CMEK.
findings.remediation: Configure default KMS keys on buckets where required.

findings.check_title: Firewall rule exposes management ports to the internet
findings.detail: Firewall rule exposes ports [443] to 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict source ranges; use IAP tunnel for SSH and remove broad rules.

findings.check_title: Firewall rule exposes management ports to the internet
findings.detail: Firewall rule exposes ports [22] to 0.0.0.0/0.
findings.remediation: Restrict source ranges; use IAP tunnel for SSH and remove broad rules.

findings.check_title: Default VPC contains open firewall rules
findings.detail: Default VPC contains open firewall rules: allow-ssh-legacy.
findings.remediation: Disable the default network; create hardened VPCs with deny-by-default rules.

findings.check_title: Disk not using customer-managed encryption key
findings.detail: Disk uses Google-managed key, not CMEK.
findings.remediation: Use CMEK for disks where compliance requires key control.

findings.detail: Shielded VM (secure boot / vTPM / integrity monitoring) is disabled.
findings.remediation: Enable secure boot, vTPM and integrity monitoring on instances.

findings.check_title: Cloud SQL instance only has public IP
findings.detail: Cloud SQL instance only has a public IP address.
findings.remediation: Assign a private IP and disable public IP on Cloud SQL instances.

findings.check_title: Cloud SQL does not require SSL
findings.detail: Cloud SQL does not require SSL/TLS connections.
findings.remediation: Set require_ssl=true (and enforce TLS 1.2+).

findings.detail: Automated backups are disabled.
findings.remediation: Enable automated backups with a suitable retention window.

findings.detail: KMS key rotation is not configured (or period > 90 days).
findings.remediation: Configure rotation period <= 90 days for symmetric keys.

findings.detail: Admin activity audit logging is not enabled for the project.
findings.remediation: Enable admin activity (and optionally data access) audit logs for all services.

findings.check_title: No log sinks for external log export
findings.detail: No log sinks export logs to an external SIEM/storage for retention and correlation.
findings.remediation: Create log sinks to BigQuery/PubSub/Storage with a retention policy.

findings.detail: GKE cluster nodes have public IPs (not a private cluster).
findings.remediation: Create private clusters with authorized networks and no public endpoint.

findings.detail: Network policy is not enabled on the cluster.
findings.remediation: Enable NetworkPolicy enforcement on the cluster.

findings.check_title: GKE uses legacy ABAC / no release channel
findings.detail: Legacy ABAC authorization is enabled (cluster-wide permissions); cluster is not enrolled in a release channel (misses managed security upgrades).
findings.remediation: Disable ABAC and enroll the cluster in a release channel.

findings.detail: External identity user:vendor@partner.com holds roles/viewer; verify it is required and governed.
findings.remediation: Remove external users or manage them through identity federation and access reviews.

findings.check_title: Service account key older than 90 days
findings.detail: Service account key is 210 days old (rotate within 90 days).
findings.remediation: Rotate keys and move workloads to workload identity.

findings.detail: Bucket has no retention policy; deleted objects cannot be recovered.
findings.remediation: Configure retention policies on buckets holding regulated data.

findings.detail: No lifecycle rules; stale or redundant objects accumulate cost and risk.
findings.remediation: Define lifecycle rules to transition and delete stale objects.

findings.detail: No lifecycle rules; stale or redundant objects accumulate cost and risk.
findings.remediation: Define lifecycle rules to transition and delete stale objects.

findings.detail: Instance has an external IP; prefer IAP or Cloud NAT for egress.
findings.remediation: Remove external IPs and use IAP/Cloud NAT.

findings.detail: Instance has an external IP; prefer IAP or Cloud NAT for egress.
findings.remediation: Remove external IPs and use IAP/Cloud NAT.

findings.detail: VPC flow logs are not enabled on this subnet.
findings.remediation: Enable VPC flow logs on subnets (sampled 50%).

findings.check_title: DNSSEC not enabled on all zones
findings.detail: DNSSEC enabled on 1/3 managed zones.
findings.remediation: Enable DNSSEC on production managed zones.

findings.check_title: Cloud SQL not encrypted with CMEK
findings.detail: Cloud SQL not encrypted with CMEK.
findings.remediation: Encrypt instances with CMEK where required.

findings.detail: Authorized networks include 0.0.0.0/0 (open to the internet).
findings.remediation: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 and restrict to trusted CIDRs / private IP.

findings.detail: Workload Identity is not enabled; pods must use long-lived keys or node IAM.
findings.remediation: Enable Workload Identity on the cluster and namespaces.

findings.detail: Shielded nodes are disabled; nodes lack secure boot and integrity monitoring.
findings.remediation: Enable shielded nodes (secure boot + integrity monitoring).

findings.detail: Cluster master endpoint is publicly accessible (private endpoint access disabled).
findings.remediation: Enable private endpoint access and disable public access.

findings.detail: All clusters send logs and metrics.
findings.remediation: Enable Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring for the cluster.

findings.detail: BigQuery dataset is publicly readable (allUsers binding).
findings.remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bindings.

findings.detail: Dataset uses Google-managed keys, not CMEK.
findings.remediation: Set a default CMEK on datasets where required.

findings.detail: Secret rotation policy is not configured.
findings.remediation: Configure rotation periods on all secrets.

findings.detail: The iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains constraint is not enforced; external principals can be added to IAM.
findings.remediation: Enforce domain-restricted sharing at the organization.

findings.check_title: VM external IP constraint not enforced
findings.detail: VM external IP constraint - enforced.
findings.remediation: Restrict compute.vmExternalIpAccess at the organization.

findings.detail: Data access audit logging is not enabled (only admin activity is captured).
findings.remediation: Enable DATA_READ/DATA_WRITE audit logs for sensitive services.

findings.detail: Cloud Run service allows unauthenticated invocation (allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers).
findings.remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers from the service IAM policy; require authentication.

findings.check_title: Cloud Run accepts all internet traffic
findings.detail: Cloud Run service accepts traffic from the internet (ingress all).
findings.remediation: Restrict ingress to internal/LB traffic.

findings.detail: Memorystore transit encryption (TLS) is disabled.
findings.remediation: Enable transit encryption (SERVER_AUTHENTICATION).

findings.detail: Memorystore AUTH is disabled; anyone who can reach the instance can read/write data.
findings.remediation: Enable AUTH with a strong password or IAM auth.

findings.detail: Memorystore instance has a public IP; no private service connect.
findings.remediation: Use Private Service Connect / VPC peering with private IPs.

findings.detail: Serial port access is enabled; interactive console access bypasses SSH controls.
findings.remediation: Disable serial-port-enable metadata on instances.

findings.detail: Confidential computing is not enabled on the instance.
findings.remediation: Enable confidential computing on sensitive workloads.

findings.detail: Access logging is not enabled on the bucket.
findings.remediation: Enable access logging to a dedicated log bucket.

findings.check_title: Primitive role assigned to a service account
findings.detail: No primitive roles on service accounts.
findings.remediation: Replace primitive roles with least-privilege roles.

findings.detail: CPU is always allocated (throttling disabled); billing and attack surface increase.
findings.remediation: Re-enable CPU throttling for request-driven services.

findings.detail: Maximum instances is unlimited; a traffic spike can scale without bound.
findings.remediation: Set a maximum instance count per service.

findings.detail: Artifact Registry repository is publicly readable.
findings.remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers from repository IAM.

findings.detail: Repository is not encrypted with a customer-managed key.
findings.remediation: Configure a customer-managed encryption key.

findings.detail: Node auto-upgrade is disabled; node OS and kubelet fixes are applied late.
findings.remediation: Enable node auto-upgrade on all node pools.

findings.detail: Node auto-repair is disabled; unhealthy nodes are not replaced automatically.
findings.remediation: Enable node auto-repair on all node pools.

findings.detail: Instance deletion protection is disabled; an accidental delete destroys the VM.
findings.remediation: Enable deletion protection on production instances.

findings.detail: OS Login is not enforced; instances rely on SSH keys that are hard to revoke.
findings.remediation: Enforce the compute.requireOsLogin organization constraint.

findings.detail: Point-in-time recovery is disabled; data can only be restored to the last backup.
findings.remediation: Enable point-in-time recovery in backup configuration.

findings.detail: Persistence is disabled; cached data is lost on failover or maintenance.
findings.remediation: Enable RDB/AOF persistence on production caches.

findings.detail: Cloud Function is publicly invokable by any caller.
findings.remediation: Require authentication on the function trigger.

findings.detail: Cloud Function has no VPC connector; it cannot reach private resources securely.
findings.remediation: Attach a VPC connector for private resource access.

findings.detail: Tunnel uses IKEv1; the deprecated protocol is weaker and unsupported for new use.
findings.remediation: Recreate tunnels with IKEv2.

findings.detail: Workload identity pool has no OIDC/JWT provider; external federation cannot be trusted.
findings.remediation: Add an OIDC/JWT provider to the pool or remove it.

findings.detail: Firewall rule logging is disabled; denied/allowed traffic is not recorded.
findings.remediation: Enable firewall rule logging for production rules.

findings.detail: Binary Authorization is disabled; unsigned or malicious images can be deployed.
findings.remediation: Enable Binary Authorization (GKE default deny) on clusters.

findings.detail: Cloud Run service has no VPC connector; it cannot reach private resources securely.
findings.remediation: Attach a VPC connector to the service.

findings.check_title: Vertex AI notebook with public external IP
findings.detail: Vertex AI notebook has a public external IP; Jupyter access and the instance are reachable from the internet.
findings.remediation: Create notebooks in a VPC with no external IP; access via IAP or a bastion host.

findings.detail: Vertex AI notebook disks are not encrypted with a customer-managed key (CMEK).
findings.remediation: Attach a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) when creating the notebook instance.

findings.detail: Pub/Sub topic is not encrypted with a customer-managed key (CMEK); message data is protected only by Google-managed keys.
findings.remediation: Enable customer-managed encryption (CMEK) on the topic at creation time.
